MOSUL 20180414 Ghuffran Ahmed, 12. Her family consists of nine girls and three boys. His mother is alive, but his father was taken by Daesh when they first took Mosul, they don’t know if he is dead or alive. She lives with her uncle in the eastern parts of Mosul. We meet her in east Mosul. What is your favourite thing? My clothes, my laptop and my toys, but most of all the computer. I use it to play games and do homework. What do you like to do? I like to jump rope and to swim and to help mom and do my homework. What do you hate the most? I hate war and lies. What do you want to be when you grow up? I want to be a dentist. What are your dreams? I dream about finishing my studies. Which university do you want to attend? The Baghdad University. Why do you want to study there? Because it’s a really good university.
